countries.reasoning: China is the leading producer of cerium oxide, with extensive mining of rare earth minerals in Inner Mongolia and Sichuan; USGS 2023 data highly reliable and comprehensive.
The US has stable production mainly from Mountain Pass mine; USGS data 2023 confirms significant but smaller share compared to China.
France produces cerium oxide from Bastnasite processing; data from French geological surveys and industrial reports 2022-2023.
Australia's rare earth projects contribute substantially; production figures from Geoscience Australia 2023 and industry statistics.
India is a smaller but established producer with bastnasite deposits; production data less detailed but based on Indian Rare Earths Limited reports 2022.
